title: StampReceipt
$comment: AUTHORED object (§5.1): produced by an actor and validated against this schema. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it. NOT EXPRESSIBLE HERE, HELD BY TEST: `rate` is present exactly when the method that bought these stamps is priced by reference (§5.4, §14.3), which this schema cannot check because the method is not carried on the receipt; T-P11-4 is the court. D-136 (0.5.1) added `rate` and closed the gap this comment previously raised. D-161 (0.5.5) added `provisioning`, whose presence is likewise held by a test and not by this schema, because the receipt does not carry the request that asked for it.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

tokenId.description: The stamp token, $POSTAGE (§4.1). No other token is postage.

price.description: What was charged. §14.3: exactly what the price message current at the purchase yields (T-P11-4).

source.description: The source the Postmaster read, as the price list names it (§14.3).

pair.description: The pair the Postmaster read, as the price list names it (§14.3).

value.description: The rate the Postmaster read, as a decimal string (§14.3, D-136).

rate.description: Present exactly when the method that bought these stamps is priced by reference to another asset (§5.4, §14.3). Absent on a fixed-price method.
rate.$comment: §14.3: "the receipt records the rate used and when". T-P11-4 is the court for presence, since the receipt does not carry the method.

holder.description: Account, or public-key alias where the transfer creates the account (§4.6, T-P16-1).

provisioning.description: Present exactly when the purchase also bought the provisioned path (§4.6, §6.3, D-161). What the agent receives is coordinates, and no secret (P-13).
provisioning.$comment: T-P13-1, T-P16-1, T-P17-1. Presence is held by the tool, not by this schema: the receipt does not carry the request that asked for it, as it does not carry the method that priced it. T-P11-4 is the court for the price, under the price list's provisioning entry (§14.3).

price.description: What the provisioned path cost, under the price list current at the purchase (§14.3).

account.description: The account created for the holder, owned by the holder's key (§4.6, T-P16-1).

doorbell.description: The HCS-10 inbound topic, carrying §4.4's one-stamp fee to the treasury (T-P7-4).

log.description: The HCS-10 outbound topic. Optional in the declaration (§9.1) and so optional here.

manifestTopic.description: The agent's manifest topic, memo wishmail:manifest:1, sole submit key the agent's (§9.1, T-P17-3).

declRegistry.description: The HCS-2 declaration registry, under the native profile only (§9.2, D-70).

profileFile.description: The HCS-1 profile file, under the native profile only; no admin key (D-150).
